ambiguous-instance.means: more than one instance could serve this and none was named

auth-failed.means: the credential resolved and the source rejected it

budget-exceeded.means: the call or spend budget is spent

conflict.means: the remote changed under an update

fanout-halted.means: a fan-out stopped after a member failed

invalid-project.means: the project file does not satisfy its shape

invalid-selector.means: the selector could not be parsed

limit-exceeded.means: the operation would affect more records than the limit allows

lossy-write.means: the write cannot be represented without dropping content

no-match.means: the question was valid and the answer is nothing

no-such-source.means: no source is registered under that name

not-connected.means: the source is known but no connection is configured

not-found.means: a named ref does not exist

partial.means: some sources answered and some failed

path-escape.means: the path resolves outside the vault root

precondition-failed.means: the record changed after it was read

rate-limited.means: the source refused after the SDK retries were exhausted

secret-backend-unavailable.means: the secret store could not be reached

source-unavailable.means: the local application is not running or the bridge is unreachable

stale-result-set.means: a positional ref was resolved against a result set that has changed

unsupported-capability.means: the source cannot perform this operation

write-refused.means: a human-decision floor refused this write
